sanskrit: e̱te dhā̍va̱ntīnda̍va̱ḥ somā̱ indrā̍ya̱ ghṛṣva̍yaḥ | ma̱tsa̱rāsa̍ḥ sva̱rvida̍ḥ ||
english: These Soma-drops, the indu-streams, run swiftly on for Indra, exhilarating, intoxicating, finders of the heavenly light.

sanskrit: pra̱vṛ̱ṇvanto̍ abhi̱yuja̱ḥ suṣva̍ye varivo̱vida̍ḥ | sva̱yaṁ sto̱tre va̍ya̱skṛta̍ḥ ||
english: Pressing forward, conquering enemies, pressed for the liberal patron, finders of wide space, of themselves bestowing vigour upon the singer.

sanskrit: vṛthā̱ krīḻa̍nta̱ inda̍vaḥ sa̱dhastha̍m a̱bhy eka̱m it | sindho̍r ū̱rmā vy a̍kṣaran ||
english: The indu-drops play freely and flow straight to the one gathering-place; they have streamed forth in the wave of the river (Sindhu).

sanskrit: e̱te viśvā̍ni̱ vāryā̱ pava̍mānāsa āśata | hi̱tā na sapta̍yo̱ rathe̍ ||
english: These Pavamāna Soma-drops have attained all desirable things, like the seven bay horses harnessed to the chariot.

sanskrit: āsmi̍n pi̱śaṅga̍m indavo̱ dadhā̍tā ve̱nam ā̱diśe̍ | yo a̱smabhya̱m arā̍vā ||
english: Place in this one, O indu-drops, the tawny (Soma) as a sign for Vena — he who is ungrudging toward us.

sanskrit: ṛ̱bhur na rathya̱ṁ nava̱ṁ dadhā̍tā̱ keta̍m ā̱diśe̍ | śu̱krāḥ pa̍vadhva̱m arṇa̍sā ||
english: Like Ṛbhu fashioning a new chariot-wheel, place insight as a sign (for Vena); O bright ones, flow onward with the flood.

sanskrit: e̱ta u̱ tye a̍vīvaśa̱n kāṣṭhā̍ṁ vā̱jino̍ akrata | sa̱taḥ prāsā̍viṣur ma̱tim ||
english: These very ones have bellowed forth; the swift ones have reached the goal; from his very being they have sent forth thought.

sanskrit: e̱te somā̍sa ā̱śavo̱ rathā̍ iva̱ pra vā̱jina̍ḥ | sargā̍ḥ sṛ̱ṣṭā a̍heṣata ||
english: These swift Soma-drops, swift as racing-chariots, strong, released in streams, have roared forth.

sanskrit: e̱te vātā̍ ivo̱rava̍ḥ pa̱rjanya̍syeva vṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ | a̱gner i̍va bhra̱mā vṛthā̍ ||
english: These are wide like the winds, like the rains of Parjanya, and freely roam like the sparks of Agni.

sanskrit: e̱te pū̱tā vi̍pa̱ścita̱ḥ somā̍so̱ dadhyā̍śiraḥ | vi̱pā vy ā̍naśu̱r dhiya̍ḥ ||
english: These purified, wise Soma-drops, mixed with curds of Dadhyañc, have penetrated through all sacred hymns with their stream of inspiration.

sanskrit: e̱te mṛ̱ṣṭā ama̍rtyāḥ sasṛ̱vāṁso̱ na śa̍śramuḥ | iya̍kṣantaḥ pa̱tho raja̍ḥ ||
english: These cleansed immortal ones, having flowed on, have not grown weary; longing to worship, they illumine the paths of heaven.

sanskrit: e̱te pṛ̱ṣṭhāni̱ roda̍sor vipra̱yanto̱ vy ā̍naśuḥ | u̱tedam u̍tta̱maṁ raja̍ḥ ||
english: These, striding apart, have pervaded the backs of the two worlds (heaven and earth), and have reached this highest realm.

sanskrit: tantu̍ṁ tanvā̱nam u̍tta̱mam anu̍ pra̱vata̍ āśata | u̱tedam u̍tta̱māyya̍m ||
english: They have reached the thread being woven most high, flowing downward along the slope — and this most exalted one too.

sanskrit: tvaṁ so̍ma pa̱ṇibhya̱ ā vasu̱ gavyā̍ni dhārayaḥ | ta̱taṁ tantu̍m acikradaḥ ||
english: You, O Soma, have wrested treasures and cattle-wealth from the Paṇis; you have bellowed forth, stretching out the thread (of the sacrifice).

sanskrit: somā̍ asṛgram ā̱śavo̱ madho̱r mada̍sya̱ dhāra̍yā | a̱bhi viśvā̍ni̱ kāvyā̍ ||
english: The swift Soma-drops have streamed forth with the flood of sweet exhilaration, pervading all the hymns of vision (kāvya).

sanskrit: anu̍ pra̱tnāsa̍ ā̱yava̍ḥ pa̱daṁ navī̍yo akramuḥ | ru̱ce ja̍nanta̱ sūrya̍m ||
english: The human worshippers of old have followed the newer path; for the sake of brightness they have generated the Sun.

sanskrit: ā pa̍vamāna no bharā̱ryo adā̍śuṣo̱ gaya̍m | kṛ̱dhi pra̱jāva̍tī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: O Pavamāna, bring for us the estate of the ungiven — the niggard's home; make our refreshments rich in offspring.

sanskrit: a̱bhi somā̍sa ā̱yava̱ḥ pava̍nte̱ madya̱m mada̍m | a̱bhi kośa̍m madhu̱ścuta̍m ||
english: The Soma-drops, belonging to men, flow on with exhilarating intoxication, toward the honey-dripping cask.

sanskrit: somo̍ arṣati dharṇa̱sir dadhā̍na indri̱yaṁ rasa̍m | su̱vīro̍ abhiśasti̱pāḥ ||
english: Soma flows on, sustaining, bearing the Indra-potent juice, of excellent heroism, a guardian against curses.

sanskrit: indrā̍ya soma pavase de̱vebhya̍ḥ sadha̱mādya̍ḥ || indo̱ vāja̍ṁ siṣāsasi ||
english: For Indra, O Soma, you flow purified; joyous together with the gods, O indu, you desire to win the prize.

sanskrit: a̱sya pī̱tvā madā̍nā̱m indro̍ vṛ̱trāṇy a̍pra̱ti | ja̱ghāna̍ ja̱ghana̍c ca̱ nu ||
english: Drinking of this, (the Soma) of exhilarations, Indra smote the Vṛtras unopposed — he smote them and shall smite them now.

sanskrit: pra somā̍so adhanviṣu̱ḥ pava̍mānāsa̱ inda̍vaḥ | śrī̱ṇā̱nā a̱psu mṛ̍ñjata ||
english: The Soma-drops, the Pavamāna indu-streams, have sprung forward swiftly; being mixed (with milk), they are cleansed in the waters.

sanskrit: a̱bhi gāvo̍ adhanviṣu̱r āpo̱ na pra̱vatā̍ ya̱tīḥ | pu̱nā̱nā indra̍m āśata ||
english: The cows (of milk) have rushed forward, like waters flowing down the slope; being purified, they have reached Indra.

sanskrit: pra pa̍vamāna dhanvasi̱ somendrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve | nṛbhi̍r ya̱to vi nī̍yase ||
english: O Pavamāna, you rush forward as Soma for Indra to drink; you are led onward by the men (priests) along various (paths).

sanskrit: tvaṁ so̍ma nṛ̱māda̍na̱ḥ pava̍sva carṣaṇī̱sahe̍ | sasni̱r yo a̍nu̱mādya̍ḥ ||
english: Flow purified, O Soma, gladdener of men, conquering all peoples — you who are the winner and worthy of rejoicing.

sanskrit: indo̱ yad adri̍bhiḥ su̱taḥ pa̱vitra̍m pari̱dhāva̍si | ara̱m indra̍sya̱ dhāmne̍ ||
english: O indu, when pressed by the stones you run around the filter, you are (thereby made) fit for the seat of Indra.

sanskrit: pava̍sva vṛtrahantamo̱kthebhi̍r anu̱mādya̍ḥ | śuci̍ḥ pāva̱ko adbhu̍taḥ ||
english: Flow purified, O supreme Vṛtra-slayer, celebrated with hymns of praise — pure, purifying, and wondrous.

sanskrit: śuci̍ḥ pāva̱ka u̍cyate̱ soma̍ḥ su̱tasya̱ madhva̍ḥ | de̱vā̱vīr a̍ghaśaṁsa̱hā ||
english: Soma is called pure and purifying in the sweetness of the pressed draught — the champion of the gods, destroyer of sinful speech.

sanskrit: pava̍sva dakṣa̱sādha̍no de̱vebhya̍ḥ pī̱taye̍ hare | ma̱rudbhyo̍ vā̱yave̱ mada̍ḥ ||
english: Flow purified, O Hari (the tawny one), accomplishing skillful might, for the gods to drink — O exhilaration, (flow) for the Maruts and for Vāyu.

sanskrit: pava̍māna dhi̱yā hi̱to̱3̱̍ 'bhi yoni̱ṁ kani̍kradat | dharma̍ṇā vā̱yum ā vi̍śa ||
english: O Pavamāna, urged forward by sacred thought, crying out toward your resting place, enter into Vāyu by the law (dharman).

sanskrit: saṁ de̱vaiḥ śo̍bhate̱ vṛṣā̍ ka̱vir yonā̱v adhi̍ pri̱yaḥ ||vṛ̱tra̱hā de̍va̱vīta̍maḥ ||
english: The vigorous seer shines beautifully together with the gods, beloved in his native seat — the Vṛtra-slayer, most sought by the gods.

sanskrit: viśvā̍ rū̱pāṇy ā̍vi̱śan pu̍nā̱no yā̍ti harya̱taḥ | yatrā̱mṛtā̍sa̱ āsa̍te ||
english: Entering all forms, the desirable one goes, being purified, to where the immortals are seated.

sanskrit: a̱ru̱ṣo ja̱naya̱n gira̱ḥ soma̍ḥ pavata āyu̱ṣak | indra̱ṁ gaccha̍n ka̱vikra̍tuḥ ||
english: The ruddy Soma, with the insight of a seer, flows purified, generating hymns for life, going to Indra.

sanskrit: ā pa̍vasva madintama pa̱vitra̱ṁ dhāra̍yā kave | a̱rkasya̱ yoni̍m ā̱sada̍m ||
english: Flow purified to us, O most intoxicating one, with your stream through the filter, O seer — and take your seat at the source of the hymn (arka).

sanskrit: tam a̍mṛkṣanta vā̱jina̍m u̱pasthe̱ adi̍te̱r adhi̍ | viprā̍so̱ aṇvyā̍ dhi̱yā ||
english: Him, the powerful one, the inspired priests have cleansed upon the lap of Aditi, with fine and subtle thought.

sanskrit: taṁ gāvo̍ a̱bhy a̍nūṣata sa̱hasra̍dhāra̱m akṣi̍tam | indu̍ṁ dha̱rtāra̱m ā di̱vaḥ ||
english: The cows (of milk) have lowed toward him — the indu of a thousand streams, inexhaustible, the sustainer of heaven.

sanskrit: taṁ ve̱dhām me̱dhayā̍hya̱n pava̍māna̱m adhi̱ dyavi̍ | dha̱rṇa̱sim bhūri̍dhāyasam ||
english: The inspired ones have extolled him — the Pavamāna, nourishing greatly upon the sky, the sustainer and abundant bestower.

sanskrit: tam a̍hyan bhu̱rijo̍r dhi̱yā sa̱ṁvasā̍naṁ vi̱vasva̍taḥ | pati̍ṁ vā̱co adā̍bhyam ||
english: They have extolled him with abundant devotion — he who dwells with Vivasvat (the Sun), the inviolable lord of the sacred word.

sanskrit: taṁ sānā̱v adhi̍ jā̱mayo̱ hari̍ṁ hinva̱nty adri̍bhiḥ | ha̱rya̱tam bhūri̍cakṣasam ||
english: The kindred women (the fingers) urge him on with the pressing-stones upon the back of the (pressing-board) — the tawny, desirable one, the one of wide vision.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ hinvanti ve̱dhasa̱ḥ pava̍māna girā̱vṛdha̍m | inda̱v indrā̍ya matsa̱ram ||
english: The wise ones urge you forward, O Pavamāna strengthened by hymns, O indu, the exhilarating one for Indra.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa ka̱vir a̱bhiṣṭu̍taḥ pa̱vitre̱ adhi̍ tośate | pu̱nā̱no ghnann apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: This seer, praised with hymns, drips upon the filter; flowing purified, he drives away failings.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa indrā̍ya vā̱yave̍ sva̱rjit pari̍ ṣicyate | pa̱vitre̍ dakṣa̱sādha̍naḥ ||
english: This one, winner of heavenly light, is poured around for Indra and for Vāyu, perfecting the rite with his power in the filter.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa nṛbhi̱r vi nī̍yate di̱vo mū̱rdhā vṛṣā̍ su̱taḥ | somo̱ vane̍ṣu viśva̱vit ||
english: This one is led apart by men — Soma pressed forth, the bull, head of heaven, omniscient in the (sacred) forest growths.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa ga̱vyur a̍cikrada̱t pava̍māno hiraṇya̱yuḥ ||indu̍ḥ satrā̱jid astṛ̍taḥ ||
english: This Pavamāna desiring cattle has bellowed forth, seeking gold; the indu, all-conquering, unvanquished.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa sūrye̍ṇa hāsate̱ pava̍māno̱ adhi̱ dyavi̍ | pa̱vitre̍ matsa̱ro mada̍ḥ ||
english: This Pavamāna shines together with the Sun upon the sky; the exhilarating (drink) is intoxicating in the filter.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa śu̱ṣmy a̍siṣyadad a̱ntari̍kṣe̱ vṛṣā̱ hari̍ḥ | pu̱nā̱na indu̱r indra̱m ā ||
english: This vigorous, tawny bull has gushed down in the mid-air; the indu, flowing purified, goes to Indra.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa vā̱jī hi̱to nṛbhi̍r viśva̱vin mana̍sa̱s pati̍ḥ | avyo̱ vāra̱ṁ vi dhā̍vati ||
english: This swift one, urged on by men, omniscient, lord of the mind, runs through the woollen filter.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa pa̱vitre̍ akṣara̱t somo̍ de̱vebhya̍ḥ su̱taḥ | viśvā̱ dhāmā̍ny āvi̱śan ||
english: This Soma, pressed for the gods, has flowed through the filter, entering all the (divine) abodes.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa de̱vaḥ śu̍bhāya̱te 'dhi̱ yonā̱v ama̍rtyaḥ | vṛ̱tra̱hā de̍va̱vīta̍maḥ ||
english: This immortal god beautifies himself in his native seat — the Vṛtra-slayer, most beloved of the gods.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa vṛṣā̱ kani̍kradad da̱śabhi̍r jā̱mibhi̍r ya̱taḥ | a̱bhi droṇā̍ni dhāvati ||
english: This vigorous bull, crying loudly, restrained by the ten kindred (fingers), runs into the wooden vessels.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa sūrya̍m arocaya̱t pava̍māno̱ vica̍rṣaṇiḥ | viśvā̱ dhāmā̍ni viśva̱vit ||
english: This Pavamāna, all-observing, has caused the Sun to shine, knowing all the (divine) abodes.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa śu̱ṣmy adā̍bhya̱ḥ soma̍ḥ punā̱no a̍rṣati | de̱vā̱vīr a̍ghaśaṁsa̱hā ||
english: This vigorous, undeceivable Soma flows being purified — champion of the gods, destroyer of evil speech.

sanskrit: prāsya̱ dhārā̍ akṣara̱n vṛṣṇa̍ḥ su̱tasyauja̍sā | de̱vām̐ anu̍ pra̱bhūṣa̍taḥ ||
english: The streams of this vigorous, pressed (Soma) have flowed forth with might, shining for the gods in abundance.

sanskrit: sapti̍m mṛjanti ve̱dhaso̍ gṛ̱ṇanta̍ḥ kā̱ravo̍ gi̱rā | jyoti̍r jajñā̱nam u̱kthya̍m ||
english: The wise chanting-bards cleanse the swift horse (Soma), praising him with hymns — he who has generated light worthy of praise.

sanskrit: su̱ṣahā̍ soma̱ tāni̍ te punā̱nāya̍ prabhūvaso | vardhā̍ samu̱dram u̱kthya̍m ||
english: O Soma, those exploits of yours, O lord of abundant wealth who flowst purified, are truly victorious — increase the ocean that is worthy of praise.

sanskrit: viśvā̱ vasū̍ni sa̱ṁjaya̱n pava̍sva soma̱ dhāra̍yā | i̱nu dveṣā̍ṁsi sa̱dhrya̍k ||
english: Winning all riches, flow purified, O Soma, with your stream; drive away hatreds utterly.

sanskrit: rakṣā̱ su no̱ ara̍ruṣaḥ sva̱nāt sa̍masya̱ kasya̍ cit | ni̱do yatra̍ mumu̱cmahe̍ ||
english: Protect us well from the evil spirit, from the noise of every (foe), from reproach wherever we may be released.

sanskrit: endo̱ pārthi̍vaṁ ra̱yiṁ di̱vyam pa̍vasva̱ dhāra̍yā | dyu̱manta̱ṁ śuṣma̱m ā bha̍ra ||
english: O indu, flow purified with your stream (bringing us) earthly and heavenly wealth; bring the resplendent vigour.

sanskrit: pra dhārā̍ asya śu̱ṣmiṇo̱ vṛthā̍ pa̱vitre̍ akṣaran | pu̱nā̱no vāca̍m iṣyati ||
english: The streams of this vigorous one have flowed freely through the filter; flowing purified, he sends forth the sacred word.

sanskrit: indu̍r hiyā̱naḥ so̱tṛbhi̍r mṛ̱jyamā̍na̱ḥ kani̍kradat | iya̍rti va̱gnum i̍ndri̱yam ||
english: The indu, urged forward by the pressers, being wiped clean, cries out — he stirs up the divine power of Indra.

sanskrit: ā na̱ḥ śuṣma̍ṁ nṛ̱ṣāhya̍ṁ vī̱rava̍ntam puru̱spṛha̍m | pava̍sva soma̱ dhāra̍yā ||
english: Flow purified, O Soma, with your stream, bringing us vigour that conquers men, filled with heroes, greatly desired.

sanskrit: pra somo̱ ati̱ dhāra̍yā̱ pava̍māno asiṣyadat | a̱bhi droṇā̍ny ā̱sada̍m ||
english: Soma Pavamāna has gushed forth, overflowing with his stream; he has settled into the wooden troughs.

sanskrit: a̱psu tvā̱ madhu̍mattama̱ṁ hari̍ṁ hinva̱nty adri̍bhiḥ | inda̱v indrā̍ya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: In the waters they urge you forward with the pressing-stones, O most honey-sweet tawny one, O indu, for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: su̱notā̱ madhu̍mattama̱ṁ soma̱m indrā̍ya va̱jriṇe̍ | cāru̱ṁ śardhā̍ya matsa̱ram ||
english: Press out the most honey-sweet Soma for Indra the wielder of the thunderbolt — the lovely, exhilarating one for his divine host.
